changelog:
v5.1.1 — Posters back on Continue Watching and Pick Up & New

• Some shows and movies in Continue Watching and Pick Up & New showed an empty card instead of their poster. They now always show the current poster for that title.

• Fixed a long black screen (up to about half a minute) before some movies with surround sound started playing on certain Fire TV sticks.

• The trailer on the Home screen no longer cuts off a few seconds after it starts.

Includes everything from v5.1.0: browse Movies and Series by decade and genre.
